Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted a DuckDuckGo search snippet that (incorrectly) showed “Podiums: 1” for Héctor Rebaque and concluded he had an F1 podium without opening and verifying the source. Proper verification (e.g., Wikipedia/stats sites) shows Rebaque had 0 F1 podiums, so the only other Mexican driver with an F1 podium besides Sergio Pérez is Pedro Rodríguez.
